summary.headline: Gross revenue rose 109% YoY to INR 2,680 crore and PAT rose 45% to INR 85 crore, while net revenue fell 3% to INR 147 crore.
summary.overview: AvenuesAI (formerly Infibeam Avenues) reported Q1 FY27 gross revenue of INR 2,680 crore (+109% YoY) and PAT of INR 85 crore (+45% YoY), with EBITDA excluding other income of INR 100 crore (+41% YoY). Net revenue was INR 147 crore, down 3% YoY, and management said take rates have compressed slightly. Management guided FY27 consolidated gross revenue to INR 11,000–13,000 crore (about 35%+ growth) and EPS to INR 8.75–9.50 on the post-split face value of INR 10. The company also announced the merger of its AI subsidiary Neuromind and Phronetic AI into the parent, and a face value change from INR 1 to INR 10.

financial_highlights.change: -3% YoY (about -1% QoQ per analyst question, not confirmed by management)
vs 47% in Q1 FY26 (as cited by analyst and confirmed by CFO)

segments.name: Payments (CCAvenue, BillAvenue, ResAvenue)
segments.commentary: Core merchant acquiring; transaction volume INR 1,479 billion (+74% YoY) across utilities, government, retail, B2B and hospitality. Management says UPI is about 22% of transactions and online acquiring market share is 8-10%.

segments.name: Consumer (Rediff, RediffPay, RediffOne)
segments.commentary: RediffPay is moving out of CUG into production this month. FY27 guidance assumes no meaningful contribution from RediffPay. RediffOne is being positioned as an enterprise operating platform.

segments.name: Intelligence (Phronetic AI / Neuromind)
segments.commentary: PayCentral, described as an agentic payment platform built on Google's Agent Payments Protocol, is in early days. Neuromind is to be merged into AvenuesAI; on-prem SLM products are in early phases with impact expected 9-18 months out.

segments.name: Credit (asset-light distribution)
segments.commentary: Proposed investment of up to 2.5% in RatnaFin Capital (NBFC) and up to 7% in Online PSB Loans. Lending risk is said to remain with regulated partners; no revenue contribution quantified.

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated gross revenue guided at INR 11,000–13,000 crore, about 35% growth and above.
FY27 EPS guided at INR 8.75–9.50, on the post-corporate-action face value of INR 10.
Management says the cost base is front-loaded for AI, international expansion and financial services, and it is not building for a short-term margin spike.
EBITDA margin 'guardrail' of about 15% set by management, described as a floor rather than a target.
Management wants investors to focus on net revenue, not gross revenue, as the better indicator of progress.
Meaningful e-commerce platform/AI rewards results are expected to show up in Q3–Q4 FY27.
capex_capacity: Management ruled out large data-centre investments (hundreds of MW); it may invest selectively in smaller data-centre capacity.
Focus is on application-layer SLMs and transaction intelligence scores built on the company's transaction graph data.
Licences received: in-principle approval from Central Bank of UAE for Retail Payment Services (Cat III), and RBI authorisation to set up a prepaid payment instrument system in India.
Management said it has US expansion aspirations this year.
demand_pricing: Take rates compressed slightly, which management cited as the main reason net revenue fell 3% YoY.
Management said UPI MDR for businesses is expected on large merchants and high-value transactions, but the Act is still awaiting Rajya Sabha, presidential assent and gazette notification.
Shiprocket Checkout integration gives same-day settlement, international payments, no-cost EMI and payment links to B2C and SME merchants.
Credit distribution through RatnaFin and OPL is expected to bring merchant financing, checkout financing and working capital products to the CCAvenue ecosystem.
Management says Apple Pay and Samsung Pay are enabled on the platform; it operates on the acquiring side.

qa_highlights.question: Impact of the Neuromind merger and face value change on the Rediff DRHP timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the corporate action has no bearing on the Rediff filing, which it called a separate event. It said the process is at an early stage and some updates are on the SEBI website.

qa_highlights.question: Merchant onboarding traction on PayCentral and whether MDR is an opportunity or a threat given a 8-10% share?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said PayCentral is early, with the Indian protocol working well and international growth faster. It said MDR is positive but not finalised, and the company sees no consolidation threat on the acquiring side.

qa_highlights.question: Why EBITDA rose while net revenue fell, and should investors focus on net or gross revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said investors should focus on net revenue, and the EBITDA increase came from lower expenses. The CFO said EBITDA rose 41% YoY and margin moved from 47% to 68%.

qa_highlights.question: Why is FY27 EPS guidance flat when PAT margin is about 57%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it will protect core earnings and reinvest incremental accruals into AI, transaction intelligence and new revenue streams. It said the 2027–2029 ambition is a strong earnings base plus a large AI-led business.

qa_highlights.question: What is the AI infrastructure plan and the expected returns?
qa_highlights.answer: Management ruled out large data-centre capex. It is focused on transaction intelligence scores, financial behaviour graphs and SLM application layers, which it said LLMs cannot replicate because they lack the data.

qa_highlights.question: Top-5 client concentration and diversification?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the strategy is to go horizontal with a larger merchant base, and that international focus is on larger clients. It did not give a top-5 revenue share.

risks_watch: Net revenue fell 3% YoY, so gross growth is not translating to net revenue; watch take-rate trend.
FY27 EPS guidance (INR 8.75–9.50) is flat in a year where revenue is guided up about 35%; management is reinvesting incremental accruals.
MDR monetisation timing and pricing are uncertain pending the Act's final notification; competitive response from large incumbents is a risk.
Middle East exposure (UAE, Saudi) may be affected by the regional conflict, per management.
Rediff DRHP timing and the merger of AI subsidiaries; promoter stake increase has not been committed to a timeline.
Credit distribution (RatnaFin, OPL) depends on closing; no revenue contribution has been quantified.
